capabilities: Track wine lots with quantity, price, shelf and phased drinking windows
Consume bottles and log tastings to daily notes and wine notes
Show dashboard, monthly and sidebar views of what is drinkable, overdue or cellaring
Write rollup properties on wine notes for Bases and Dataview queries
Infer drinking windows from varietal and style
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and it makes no network requests — all prices and statistics are computed locally from the notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track a physical inventory such as wine bottles with quantities, purchase lots, drinking windows and consumption history.

relations.evidence: Read daily/monthly folders from the Journals plugin
Read the spending heading and currency from the Finance Tracker plugin

summary: Wine cellar tracker that stores each bottle as a Markdown note with lots, drinking windows, tasting logs and status views.
